messages.subject: No water and Nutrient balance result in calibration section
parts:
Hello Tam
I am trying to calibrate my model using RSWAT.  But I got some issues.
1: Running the model using SWAT+ editor, I got result with NSE 0.52 (using monthly observed discharge). But after running the model in RSWAT, the NSE decreased to -0.64. Why?
2: I tried to calibrate the model but I dont have Water/Nutrients balance values.
I really appreciate your help as I stuck at this level for a long time.

Aida
